verdict.rationale: Trivy's misconfiguration scanner docs say it ships built-in checks for IaC files, naming Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and CloudFormation, which covers this story's core. Further docs show Dockerfile-style misconfiguration checks on image configs, and a community note says Aqua retired tfsec in favor of Trivy, indirectly suggesting Trivy took over Terraform scanning. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation (CLI usage, check coverage, custom policies for IaC scans), hands-on or independent confirmation of Terraform/Kubernetes file scanning.
